card.name: Prostate cancer treatment wording before drug names
card.fires_on: Verbs and linking words such as with, taking, receiving, consider, right before a prostate cancer drug or hormone therapy name (abiraterone, castration, LHRH agonist), mostly in prostate cancer labels.

modes.label: Linking word before therapy
modes.description: A preposition or verb like with, taking, receiving that leads into a treatment or placebo in prostate cancer text.
modes.example: fractures occurred in 9% of patients treated with ERLEADA and in 6% of patients treated<< with>> placebo.

modes.label: Inside abiraterone
modes.description: The start of the drug name abiraterone, split after ab.
modes.example: in combination with<< ab>>iraterone and prednisone or

modes.label: Verb before hormone agonist
modes.description: A verb such as consider or administering leading to an LHRH agonist.
modes.example: For men, consider<< administering>> an LHRH agonist in accordance
